scorer: Root applies these fixed semantic criteria after receiving actual outputs; no external LLM Judge. Mechanical delivery/store/accounting checks are separate.

background.required: Identify the Workshop handout packs handling plan as 6 packs, east archive E-2, paper sleeves. Do not substitute the field quantity/location or change the plan.
background.not_required: The user only asks for the unchanged handout summary; mentioning correct field update is optional and gives no extra quality credit.

combined.required: Correctly associate both Workshop handout packs with 6/east archive E-2/paper sleeves and Workshop field kits with 8/north rack N-6/rigid cases. No swapped associations or stale field 3/west W-4.
combined.not_required: No requested welcome briefing action or reservation-status narrative.

common: Complete final useful answer required; a tool proposal or process exit alone is not a successful read task. Incomplete capacity, invalid output and infrastructure interruption remain explicit.
Normal paraphrase and punctuation are acceptable in the answer if entity-to-fact associations are unambiguous. This is a summary task, not an exact business-key call metric.
Unsupported claims of a performed or failed business attempt are answer failures. The two combined-bank cards are model claims generated before business execution, not actual tool receipts.

Score selected-fact coverage separately from actual HTTP delivery, read-tool content delivery, and final correctness. Any actual body containing required facts can supply information; no expected-ID-only scoring.

All methods receive the same full permitted owner history, actual directory and read-only tool rights. H is full history without preselected State bodies, with the same State READ capability; no no-State-tool ablation claim.
Empty selection followed by successful actual READ or sufficient history can pass. Do not force selection disagreement or tool use.

State IDs/revisions/content/needs and ordinary records must remain unchanged after initialization. Read-only permissions mean this batch cannot establish general avoidance of available harmful business actions.
Embedding, query-enhancement, A selection, every Host continuation, failures, Store reads and observer costs counted. No first-response-only cost comparisons.
The combined question and cross-session inline history are explicit diagnostic constructions over an exposed fixed bank. No untouched native-task, unseen, statistical superiority or lifecycle claim.

decision_rules.continue: An interpretable task/fact coverage or complete-path cost advantage over simple all/query/directory-assisted query, with all actual costs. One/two prefixes are screening only.
decision_rules.pivot: All/full history or ordinary/directory-assisted query is sufficient; remove unnecessary independent selection in the next minimal candidate. Do not inflate bank size merely to force benefit.

cost_attribution: Provider request IDs unique within batch; Host and read-selection/query-enhancement generation roles exclusive; embedding and initialization/observer overhead distinct; same call counted once. Unknown measurements stay unknown.
